teaser: A suitcase, half-zipped, waits by the door for three days before anyone leaves. You are a 5, reached through the compound number 14 — the sum of a birth date before it reduces to one digit, called Movement and Challenge — and you are an ISFJ, built to notice what a house needs before anyone has to ask. The 5 leans toward the door; the ISFJ keeps checking the stove is off before it goes. Neither one wins outright in you. The bag gets packed, then unpacked to add one more thing someone else might need, then packed again.
excerpt: The smell of wet dog and cut grass is the backdrop the first time a partner hears you say you need the weekend alone, no explanation attached.
